items.title: Ukraine’s Zelenskyy set to meet Trump as Iran and Ukraine wars converge
items.description: The US Senate will vote Tuesday on Russian sanctions, days after Ukraine attacked an Iranian vessel in the Caspian Sea.

items.title: West Bank woman delivers stillborn baby after Israeli soldiers delay checkpoint
items.description: Medics frantically looked for an open route to transport the 28-year-old woman, who was six months pregnant and unconscious, to a nearby hospital. While waiting for more than 30 minutes at an Israeli checkpoint, the woman was forced to deliver her stillborn baby inside the ambulance.

items.title: Searching for Sudan’s looted treasures
items.description: Since Sudan's civil war began, looters have stolen thousands of valuable artifacts from the country's museums. Now, authorities are trying to get them back.

items.title: Montenegro Ends Visa-Free Entry for Russians Amid 2028 EU Membership Bid
items.description: Montenegro has remained one of the few European countries to offer visa-free entry to Russians for up to 30 days, and saw a massive influx of anti-war Russian citizens after the 2022 invasion of Ukraine.

items.title: More than 600 US military service members injured since Iran War began in February
items.description: The latest figure includes casualties from Operation Fury and a new category called "Overseas Operations".

items.title: Can the U.S. and Iran take the off-ramp?
items.description: The U.S. military has paused its airstrikes on Iran after nearly two weeks of intensifying bombing, while diplomatic efforts have pushed forward to try to avert a return to all-out war.

items.title: Sudan civil war: Civilians used as 'human shields'
items.description: The situation in the besieged city of El Obeid in Sudan is worsening by the day, with rights organizations warning of mass atrocities. Children are traumatized and do not dare go to school.

items.description: A Polish-manufactured FlyEye reconnaissance drone was utilized by Ukraine’s 26th Separate Artillery Brigade to identify and destroy a Russian ammunition storage facility in the Bakhmut sector. items.title: Zelenskyy Says Russia Wants To Bring More North Korean Troops Into Ukraine War
items.description: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said that Moscow wants to bring in thousands of North Korean soldiers again for its invasion of Ukraine, with preparations in Russia having been under way since early summer.
